description.value: Lions Pub is a traditional English-style pub in Vancouver's Coal Harbour neighbourhood, operating as the publicly accessible portion of the private Terminal City Club. It serves classic British fare — bangers and mash, Scotch eggs, Welsh rarebit, Yorkshire pudding, and daily house-made savoury pies — alongside over 27 draught and 25 bottled beers, with both indoor and outdoor patio seating. Positioned steps from Waterfront Station, Canada Place, and the cruise ship terminal, it sits at a natural convergence point for cyclists travelling Vancouver's downtown waterfront corridor.
